_comment: RECORDED outputs of a REGRESSED triage system (the planted regression). This represents a degraded model — e.g. after a re-quantisation or a prompt edit that made it timid — which now under-classifies the malicious class, marking real attacks as 'benign' (the dangerous false 'all clear'). Overall accuracy still looks deceptively okay because it gets the benign majority right, which is exactly why accuracy is the wrong metric: recall on malicious collapses. The regression gate must catch this and fail the build.
